labels.IN-CORPUS: same dataset listed in the model's own pretraining corpus
labels.PARTIAL: downstream set is a subset/derivative of a pretraining corpus (TUAB, TUEV, TUSL, TUAR, TUSZ are TUH/TUEG sub-corpora); see exclusion_claim for authors' mitigation
labels.HELD-OUT: not in the pretraining corpus as listed
labels.UNCLEAR: pretraining corpus not enumerated or downstream/pretraining identity ambiguous
